title: Snap Mode
description: A single-presentation demo capsule that shows only the mobile Snap reading surface.

sections.title: Snap mode
sections.body: One screen at a time. Swipe up to move to the next panel — each one snaps fully into view.

sections.title: Built for thumbs
sections.body: Snap turns a document into a vertical deck of full-screen panels: calm, focused, one idea per screen.

sections.title: Still a document
sections.body: Snap is a reading layout, not an app. The same words live in the capsule's readable HTML underneath this view.

sections.title: No JavaScript needed
sections.body: Snapping is pure CSS scroll-snap. It works even with scripts disabled, which keeps the capsule safe to preview.

sections.title: That's snap
sections.body: Scroll back up any time. Every panel is part of one sealed, portable HTML capsule.
